_comment: Copy this to rokudeploy.json (gitignored) and fill in your Roku's Developer-Mode IP + dev password. roku-deploy zips the transpiled staging output and sideloads it. NOTE the explicit `files` — roku-deploy's DEFAULT files list does NOT include fonts/, so without this the bundled TTFs never reach the device and custom-font text renders blank.
_comment_delete: deleteInstalledChannel:false makes a re-sideload REPLACE the dev channel in place instead of uninstalling it first — which PRESERVES the registry (server URL, token, caps-done) across builds, so you don't re-onboard/re-login every sideload. (A true uninstall via the Roku dev UI still clears it.)
